 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Sunil Kumar Panwar
 Oral Order
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

The petitioner has prayed for regular bail in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 363, 366A but later on cognizance has been taken under Sections 363, 366A, 376 and 109 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4/8/17 of the POCSO Act.
As per FIR, the allegation against the petitioner along with co-accused persons is that they kidnapped daughter of the informant.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence.
He has falsely been implicated in this case.

The victim is a mature girl, aged about 18 years and as per her statement recorded Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.13992 of 2023(3) dt.20-06-2023 under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C. which is annexed with case diary, wherein she stated that she went Ludhiana with the petitioner with her own sweetwill and thereafter they solemnized marriage in a temple.
It is further submitted that the petitioner is languishing in judicial custody since 08.12.2022.
Learned APP appearing for the state has opposed the prayer of regular bail.

The above named petitioner is directed to be released on bail in connection with Atri P.S. Case No. 349 of 2022 on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Exclusive Special Judge POCSO-cum Additional Sessions Judge-VII,
Gaya.
